## Description {#details}

<p>Two offsets pointing to a continuous substring.</p>


<p>End is not included, i.e. represents a half-open range.</p>


<p>Definition at line 57 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/testing/include/llvm/testing/annotations/annotations-h">Annotations.h</a>.</p>
